product_overview: A comprehensive web-based platform supporting coffee industry stakeholders—farmers, processors, roasters, and cuppers—in farm management, traceability, quality control, and operational efficiency through integrated dashboards, data hubs, and AI-powered analytics.
core_goals: Enable end-to-end traceability from farm to consumer for coffee products.
Provide farmers tools to effectively manage farms, harvests, soil health, compliance, and weather conditions.
Support processors and roasters in managing inventories, processing batches, and quality assessments.
Facilitate cupping sessions, coffee competitions, and quality insights for stakeholders.
Deliver secure user management with role-based access control across the platform.
Integrate AI capabilities for intelligent recommendations and operational insights.
key_features: Authentication System with JWT and role-based authorization including login, registration, password reset, and first login setup.
Farmer Dashboard presenting farm overview, harvest lots, and key performance statistics in an intuitive interface.
Complete Farm Management covering adding, editing, viewing farms with geolocation and detailed soil analysis.
Harvest Lot Management supporting creation and detailed tracking of harvest lots with quality and processing histories.
Soil Analysis tools recording detailed metrics and providing recommendations per farm soil profiles.
Weather Monitoring integrating Open-Meteo API to track weather records for farms with visualization.
GAP Compliance Helper assisting farmers in logging and tracking Good Agricultural Practices for certification.
Farmer Data Hub consolidating all farm data, harvests, soil analyses, and weather records for easy review.
Processor Workbench managing processing batches, drying logs, green bean lots, and invoicing workflows.
Roaster Workbench enabling inventory management, roast batch tracking, and green bean lot oversight.
Cupping Sessions feature for managing cupping sessions, scoring by judges, and competition oversight.
Competition Dashboard for managing coffee competitions with session and judge administration.
Quality Insights dashboard providing analytics on quality metrics, trends, and cupping scores.
Traceability System displaying complete lot histories and chain of custody from farm to consumer.
User Management interface for administrative control of users, roles, permissions, and ownership transfer.
Admin Management tools for maintaining activity types, process types, coffee varieties, and farm data.
Sales Management encompassing customer, sales order, invoice, and pricing history management.
Crop Year Management organizing harvest data by crop season years.
Notifications system for managing and displaying actionable user notifications.
Common UI Components for consistent design elements including buttons, forms, modals, tables, badges, and statistics cards.
Layout Components for consistent application navigation through sidebar and header layouts.
API Utilities providing base HTTP request functions with built-in authentication handling.
AI Integration leveraging Google Gemini AI for intelligent features, recommendations, and insights.
user_flow_summary: Users register or login through the Authentication System with role-based access.
Farmers access the Farmer Dashboard to overview farms, manage harvest lots, soil analyses, and monitor weather.
Farmers add or update farms with location and soil data and track GAP compliance.
Processors use the Processor Workbench to manage processing batches, drying logs, and generate invoices.
Roasters utilize the Roaster Workbench for inventory and roast batch management.
Cuppers coordinate cupping sessions, judge scoring, and manage coffee competitions via dedicated interfaces.
Administrators handle user roles, permissions, and site-wide configurations via User and Admin Management modules.
Users receive notifications for relevant actions and system alerts.
Data flows continuously between front-end components and backend APIs powered by Prisma ORM and PostgreSQL.
AI capabilities assist users providing recommendations and operational insights within workflows.
validation_criteria: All authentication flows must securely handle user credentials with JWT and password encryption.
Farm and harvest data must be accurately stored and retrievable with full audit trails and versioning.
Traceability system must show complete lot histories with chain of custody without data gaps.
Quality metrics and cupping scores must calculate correctly and display real-time trends.
User role based access must restrict feature access appropriately across farmer, processor, roaster, cupper, and admin roles.
Integration with external APIs (Open-Meteo, Google Gemini AI) must handle errors gracefully and provide fallback UX.
UI components must conform to design consistency and be responsive across devices.
All API endpoints must validate input and authenticate requests securely.
Notifications must trigger appropriately and be delivered reliably to users.
Data export and reports (e.g., CSV exports) must generate correctly with valid formatting.
